bounded_source_assessment.type: source safeguard and conditional policy, not a new defect count
bounded_source_assessment.analysis: When capture_ground is called with disabled TerrainIkMode, it subtracts the root ground offset from the subject global Y coordinate. A finite resulting SupportElevation selects CaptureGround::AuthoredPlane; nonfinite admission records Geometry rejection and returns None, without selecting terrain in that branch. collect_bones then uses the selected finite plane for each present report bone and retains computed clearance as Some. The check admits a finite datum; it does not establish the datum represents a physical measured terrain surface or that every subsequent floating-point clearance is finite.
bounded_source_assessment.qualification: This supports the historical named source-level policy at the selected boundary. Applicability of the plane, missing bones, finite computed clearance and actual capture behavior require separate evidence.

bounded_source_assessment.analysis: ScenarioTerrain::Authored is a scenario classification, not CaptureGround::AuthoredPlane. The displayed per-frame policy maps Authored to enabled terrain IK; given enabled mode, capture_ground chooses CaptureGround::Terrain. Absent scenarios and out-of-window Toggle frames select disabled mode under that policy, where the separate authored-plane observation branch is used.
bounded_source_assessment.qualification: This is a composition of selected source paths, not a claim that no intervening system could change the runtime resource. Earlier q2301/13U reads and this independent registered trace retain separate authorship.

bounded_source_assessment.type: relationship to 13U/q2301, not an inferred alias
bounded_source_assessment.analysis: Initial root admission asks for required terrain at origin even when a later observation mode will be disabled. In fixture_root_position quickstep requires terrain regardless of IK mode; non-quickstep enabled IK requires terrain; the disabled non-quickstep path retains current Y after admitting the horizontal point. Full-ragdoll root has its own required terrain lookup. A missing required query becomes MissingSupport and a typed Terrain rejection in the selected path; earlier driver state may already have changed.
bounded_source_assessment.qualification: The prior 13U/q2301 disposition concerns the selected required-root paths, not a proof that the entire capture is terrain-independent when disabled or that every terrain producer/runtime case is valid.

bounded_source_assessment.type: relation to existing clearance and terrain-observation ledger rows, without duplicate or alias decision
bounded_source_assessment.analysis: For CaptureGround::Terrain, invalid bone plan positions or unavailable per-bone terrain height yield None for that bone's clearance; missing bones are not inserted. BoneSample retains Option<f32>. The selected guard-step calculation maps missing endpoint clearance to a zero gain; the foot-terrain-relief reduction skips unavailable observations and returns zero if no finite extrema remain. The selected landing-foot validation instead requires a present clearance meeting its threshold, so missing handling is not uniform across consumers.
bounded_source_assessment.qualification: The existing REVIEW-CAPTURE-TERRAIN-OBSERVATION-ZERO-95E and CAPTURE-GROUND-CLEARANCE-ADMISSION-95E rows already describe separately attributed conditional questions; no actual missing support, nonfinite clearance, accepted report, or unique new finding was observed. Valid disabled-plane selection neither proves those optional terrain values exist nor resolves their required/nonapplicable policy.
